name: Jolly: Anniversary Edition
storyline:
November 5th, 2017.

Welcome to Jolly Entertainment! A company built on the dreams of children all over America to bring you the best entertainment possible on the West Coast. Or so “they” say.

Play through the eyes of Mikhail Schmidt, a job hopper who snuck himself too deep into a situation to get out so easily. Now he has to face the skeletons in this company’s closet and finally let them have a peaceful life.

Will you be able to set them free? Or will you let them decay away?
summary: "Jolly: Anniversary Edition" is a fan-remake made from the ground up of the original "Jolly 1" by IvanG. This is designed to give the original game a fresh new coat of paint with better polished gameplay and a new story that helps it connect to the wider Jolly story.
